hints.title: Sorted Rewards
hints.text: Sort and deduplicate rewardValues. A reward v can only be collected if current sum x < v.

hints.title: Upper Bound
hints.text: Since x < v, any new sum is strictly less than 2 * max(rewardValues) <= 4000.

hints.title: Bitset Reachability
hints.text: Maintain achievable sums as bits in an integer mask. Collectable sums with reward v are (mask & ((1 << v) - 1)) << v.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Bitwise operations process 64 bits per CPU cycle.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Standard knapsack DP table updates take O(n * M) which is slower than bitset operations.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(1) extra space using single big integer.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use bitset acceleration to transition subset sums in O(M / 64).
